task: Align Chart.yaml version and appVersion to 0.4.1 for the v0.4.1 tag, the complete re-release after the partial v0.4.0 (part of #26)

events.summary: v0.4.0 (run 33769700751) was a partial release: helm-release failed at the OCI chart signature (UNAUTHORIZED, fixed by #134) and release-manifest/release-bundle were skipped. Tags are never re-pointed (docs/dependency-incident-response.md), so the complete release is cut as v0.4.1; the release-preflight guard (#130) requires Chart version and appVersion to equal the tag.
events.provenance: GitHub Actions run 33769700751 and user decision 2026-09-04

events.summary: Only Chart.yaml version/appVersion change. CHANGELOG.md is generated by git-cliff on tag (release.yaml changelog/update-changelog jobs) and is not edited. Chart 0.4.1/0.4.1 were never published (last release v0.3.0; no gh-pages index), so moving version 0.4.1 -> 0.4.1 does not collide with a published artifact. No template, values, RBAC or code change.
runtime: `make release-preflight TAG=v0.4.1` on origin/main (Chart 0.4.0/0.4.0) fails: version and appVersion must match the tag.

Set version: 0.4.1 and appVersion: "0.4.1" in charts/nfs-quota-agent/Chart.yaml. Default `helm template` now renders image ghcr.io/dasomel/nfs-quota-agent:0.4.1 and helm.sh/chart: nfs-quota-agent-0.4.1.

`make release-preflight TAG=v0.4.1` exits 0 after the change; `helm lint charts/nfs-quota-agent` clean; `helm template` default renders the 0.4.1 image tag and chart label; trace evaluated with evaluate.py and gated against baseline.eval.json.
events.scope: Chart metadata, release-preflight guard, helm lint/render, behavior-contract trace validation. The release workflow itself only runs on the v* tag and is not exercised here.
